text:
Miriam C.: Posting a short proposal: let's standardize postmortem follow-ups into a tiny 'Action Audit Playbook' so items don't drift. Key goals: clear ownership, measurable SLAs, verifiable closure, recurrence detection.

Jules P.: Love it. Can you sketch the smallest possible template? We want something teams will actually use.

Miriam C.: Sure 00char template:

```
Action | Owner | Backup | Priority | Due | SLA_hours | AcceptanceCriteria | VerificationOwner | EvidenceLink | RecurrenceTag | State
```

Rules I propose:
- Owner must ack in thread or via assign within 48h
- If SLA_hours exceeded -> ping Backup -> team lead -> IC escalation
- Verification required before Closed: VerificationOwner posts EvidenceLink meeting AcceptanceCriteria
- Recurrence: auto-flag if same RecurrenceTag appears in >=3 incidents in 180d

Theo - oncall: For rotations: propose 4-week primary IC rotation, with a 1-week overlap to hand off. Rotation IC's responsibility: weekly triage of open actions, trigger escalations, maintain the board. I'll volunteer to run the calendar invites for the pilot.

incident-bot: [automated] I can: post weekly digest, ping owners ahead of SLA, and create follow-up incidents when SLA missed by >7d. Config: reminder_offsets=[48h,SLA/2], channels=[#eng-oncall].

Kate (PM): For comms cadence: initial PM summary within 24h, status email at 7d, verification/closure note at 30d. If action open at 90d, include exec summary + mitigation plan. Use the playbook to populate those beats.

Jules P.: Also suggest a tiny "heat" score: Low/Med/High derived from Priority + recurrence count. Use it to order weekly triage.

Miriam C.: Pilot plan: run this playbook for the next 12 postmortems. Metrics: percent of actions acked within 48h, 7/30/90 closure rates, mean time to verification, and number of recurrence flags. If pilot looks good, we'll add the template to the postmortem checklist.

Theo - oncall: Implementation notes: 1) quick Google Sheet with the fields above for rapid rollout, 2) require creating tracker issue for any action with SLA>72h, 3) wire incident-bot for reminders/escalations. ETA: sheet + bot config by next Wednesday (1854080000).

Miriam C.: One more operational rule: owner OOO >5 business days -> auto-assign to Backup and note original owner on return. Keeps progress moving.

incident-bot: [automated] Acknowledged. Will support OOO auto-assignment when provided with backups_map.

Kate (PM): I'll draft the email templates for 24h/7d/30d beats and the exec 90d ping. Happy to review the sheet before pilot.

Jules P.: Can we also capture AcceptanceCriteria as a one-line check so closure is objective? e.g., "Load test shows error rate <0.1% for 24h".

Miriam C.: Agreed. All actions must include one-line AcceptanceCriteria. Thanks all 0 for quick feedback. If you want to join the pilot, react or DM @Theo. :white_check_mark:
